source.title: The Tale of Benjamin Bunny
source.author: Beatrix Potter
source.canonicalisation: Reviewed benchmark projection of the story body from Project Gutenberg ebook 14407. Project Gutenberg boilerplate, publisher/copyright front matter, illustration placeholders, and typographic display headings are omitted; the story title is normalized to one Markdown H1 and the narrative wording is otherwise retained.

workCategoryReferences.fact: Project Gutenberg classifies ebook 14407 as English juvenile belles lettres and Category: Text.

authorshipReferences.fact: Project Gutenberg identifies Beatrix Potter as the sole author of The Tale of Benjamin Bunny.

references.fact: Project Gutenberg identifies the author as Potter, Beatrix, 1866-1943.
The library catalogue describes The Tale of Benjamin Bunny as first published in 1904.
The scanned source front matter for ebook 14407 records Copyright, 1904 by Frederick Warne & Co.
Ebook 14407 is English, identifies Beatrix Potter as author, and lists no translator for the source text.
Ebook 14407 identifies Beatrix Potter as author and credits the Project Gutenberg team for digital production rather than an additional textual contribution.
The work is recorded as first published in 1904, so it was not unpublished at the end of 1988.
